title: Deleted Edges Reappear On Zoom
description: When deleting selected edges in puzzle2d, edges disappear but reappear after zoom. Root cause: reconcileHostDeclarativeSceneEdges restores edges from hostDeclarativeSceneDescriptor when scene edge count drops below declarativeSceneEdgeExpectation without updating the snapshot after user deletes.
summary: Fixed source-pane-only edge resurrection after interaction. User deletes now mark authoritativeStructuralSuppressions so rememberHostDeclarativeSceneDescriptor, puzzle2dEnsureSceneEdgesFromDescriptor, mergeWasmHostAuthoredEdgesIntoDescriptor, and reconcile ignore stale JSX until fixture commits; spurious wasm edgeDelete restore skips suppressed ids; deleteSelectedObjects pushes descriptor to WASM immediately. 141 react tests pass.
